heading: Faisal Town Phase 2 Buyer FAQs
faqsText:
What are the current Faisal Town Phase 2 plot prices? | Prices vary by sector, plot size, location and current availability. Sector P / The Caladan currently has listed full-payment prices on this website, while other sectors should be checked individually before making a decision. | yes
Which plot sizes are available in Sector P? | The current Sector P price table includes multiple residential sizes from 5.56 Marla upward. Availability of a specific plot should be confirmed before payment. | yes
Which sectors are part of Faisal Town Phase 2? | The website currently covers Sector O / Model Block, Sector P / The Caladan, Sector R, Sector S, Sector T and Overseas Enclave 05. | yes
Is the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan available? | Yes. The homepage and Phase 2 pages provide access to the current master-plan reference so buyers can compare sector locations before shortlisting a property. | yes
Can I arrange a Faisal Town Phase 2 site visit? | Yes. Send your preferred sector, plot size and budget on WhatsApp and we can help you narrow suitable options before arranging a visit. | yes
Are corner, boulevard or park-facing plots priced differently? | Special-location factors can affect the total price or applicable charges. Confirm the exact plot and all charges before making payment. | yes
How do I confirm current plot availability? | Use the WhatsApp enquiry buttons on the website and mention the sector, plot size and budget you are considering. Current availability should be checked before proceeding. | yes
Can overseas Pakistanis shortlist plots remotely? | Yes. Overseas buyers can use WhatsApp to review current options, maps, basic location information and next-step guidance before arranging local representation or a visit. | yes
